items.raw_excerpt: Rows of black and white plastic weed mats are giving vegetable seedlings their best start in life. But disposing of them has become a logistical and cost burden.
items.summary_en: Plastic weed mats help vegetable seedlings grow, but farmers have no good way to dispose of them. The mounting waste has become a costly problem for farms across Australia.

items.raw_excerpt: Some of the Island's oldest burial grounds are at risk, as coastal erosion washes away the land beneath them. People are doing what they can to protect those cemeteries but, as CBC's Cody MacKay explains, eventually they will be lost to the sea.
items.summary_en: Coastal erosion is washing away land beneath Prince Edward Island's oldest burial grounds. People are trying to protect the cemeteries, but the graves will eventually be lost to the sea.

El proyecto busca devolver a la comunidad un espacio más accesible, seguro y moderno. items.summary_en: The Plaza del Pueblo in Valparaíso is getting a major makeover with new lighting, accessibility features and landscaping. The government project invests over 1.3 billion pesos and will run until December 2026.
